case.question: Show all transactions from last year.
case.reference_sql: SELECT * FROM transactions WHERE transaction_date BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31';

result.question: Show all transactions from last year.
result.message: Returns all transactions that occurred between 2022-01-01 and 2022-12-31. The query returned no rows.
result.sql: SELECT p.portfolio_name, s.symbol, t.transaction_type, t.quantity, t.price, t.transaction_date, t.fees FROM transactions t JOIN portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = t.portfolio_id JOIN securities s ON s.security_id = t.security_id WHERE t.transaction_date BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31';

case.question: Which sector has the most securities?
case.reference_sql: SELECT sec.sector_name FROM securities s JOIN sectors sec ON sec.sector_id = s.sector_id GROUP BY sec.sector_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

result.question: Which sector has the most securities?
result.message: Returns the sector with the highest number of associated securities.
result.sql: SELECT s.sector_name, COUNT(sec.security_id) AS security_count FROM sectors s JOIN securities sec ON sec.sector_id = s.sector_id GROUP BY s.sector_id, s.sector_name ORDER BY security_count DESC LIMIT 1;

attempts.explanation: Returns the sector with the highest number of associated securities.
